title: ParAnimator parameter catalog
description: Describes Id parameters, fractal-specific params slots, and formula-specific knobs that can be animated.

parameters.description: Top-level animated Id parameters keyed by parameter name.

fractal-types.description: Fractal-type-specific metadata keyed by Id fractal type name.

additionalProperties.description: Metadata for one Id fractal type.

params.description: Metadata for the fractal type's params= slots.

format.description: Format used by the complete params= value.

slots.description: Individual scalar params= slots for this fractal type.

groups.description: Named multi-slot params= groups for this fractal type.

formula-entries.description: Formula-specific metadata keyed by formula entry name.

parameter-metadata.description: Animation metadata for one Id parameter or derived parameter target.

type.description: Application data type used to validate and interpolate the parameter.

format.description: Text format used when writing the value to an Id par file.

default-curve.description: Default interpolation curve for tracks targeting this parameter.

extrapolate.description: Behavior outside the explicit keyframe range.

min.description: Optional inclusive minimum numeric component value.

max.description: Optional inclusive maximum numeric component value.

arity.description: Required component count for tuple-like values.

normalize.description: Normalize vector alias values after interpolation.

params-slot-metadata.description: Metadata for one scalar slot in an Id params= value.

name.description: Human-readable slot name used in track keys.

type.description: Application data type for this params= slot.

format.description: Text format used by this slot track value.

default-curve.description: Default interpolation curve for this slot.

extrapolate.description: Behavior outside this slot's keyframe range.

min.description: Optional inclusive minimum numeric slot value.

max.description: Optional inclusive maximum numeric slot value.

arity.description: Required component count for tuple-like slot values.

normalize.description: Normalize vector alias slot values after interpolation.

params-group-metadata.description: Metadata for a named group of slots in an Id params= value.

type.description: Application data type for the grouped params= value.

format.description: Text format used by the grouped params= value.

default-curve.description: Default interpolation curve for this params= group.

extrapolate.description: Behavior outside this group's keyframe range.

min.description: Optional inclusive minimum numeric component value.

max.description: Optional inclusive maximum numeric component value.

arity.description: Required component count for tuple-like group values.

normalize.description: Normalize vector alias group values after interpolation.

slots.description: Zero-based params= slots occupied by this group.

formula-entry-metadata.description: Metadata for one formula entry name.

params.description: Human-readable knobs mapped to the formula p1 through p4 variables.

knobs.description: Formula parameter knobs keyed by human-readable knob name.

functions.description: Formula function slots mapped to the Id function= parameter.

fn1.description: First function= slot exposed as formula variable fn1.

fn2.description: Second function= slot exposed as formula variable fn2.

fn3.description: Third function= slot exposed as formula variable fn3.

fn4.description: Fourth function= slot exposed as formula variable fn4.

formula-params-knob-metadata.description: Metadata for one human-readable formula params knob.

variable.description: Fixed formula variable component used by this knob, such as p1.real or p2.

format.description: Text format used by this formula knob value.

default-curve.description: Default interpolation curve for this formula knob.

extrapolate.description: Behavior outside this formula knob's keyframe range.

min.description: Optional inclusive minimum numeric knob value.

max.description: Optional inclusive maximum numeric knob value.

arity.description: Required component count for tuple-like knob values.

normalize.description: Normalize vector alias knob values after interpolation.

variable.description: Complete p1 through p4 variable used by a complex knob.

oneOf.description: Integer formula knob.
Real formula knob.

variable.description: Real or imaginary p1 through p4 component used by a scalar knob.

oneOf.description: Complex knob mapped to a complete p1 through p4 variable.
Integer knob mapped to one real or imaginary p1 through p4 component.
Real knob mapped to one real or imaginary p1 through p4 component.

formula-function-metadata.description: Metadata for one formula function slot.

type.description: Declares this formula function slot as an enum.

oneOf.description: Value must be one of Id's recognized formula functions.

values.description: Named value set used for the enum.

oneOf.description: Use the fixed function names recognized by Id.

format.description: Text format used by this function enum value.

default-curve.description: Default interpolation curve for this function slot.

extrapolate.description: Behavior outside this function slot's keyframe range.

parameter-type.description: Application data type used for validation and interpolation.

oneOf.description: Id center-mag value containing center real, center imaginary, and magnification.
Complex value represented by two numeric components.
Id corners value represented by four or six numeric components.
Floating-point numeric value.
Discrete string value selected from a declared value set.
Integral numeric value.
Fixed-arity tuple of floating-point numeric components.
Two-component point alias over numeric-tuple.
Three-component point alias over numeric-tuple.
Two-component vector alias over numeric-tuple.
Three-component vector alias over numeric-tuple.

parameter-format.description: Text format used for parameter values in JSON and par output.

oneOf.description: Value is written as a single raw token.
Value components are written as slash-delimited tokens.
Value is a slash-delimited list with type-specific length.
Value is exactly two slash-delimited tokens.

curve.description: Interpolation curve used between two keyframes.

oneOf.description: Geometric interpolation, currently used for magnification values.
Hold the source value until the destination key.
Linearly interpolate numeric values.
Step from the source value to the destination value at the destination key.

extrapolate.description: Behavior for frames outside a track's explicit keyframe range.

oneOf.description: Use the source par value outside the keyframe range.
Use the nearest keyframe value outside the keyframe range.
Repeat the keyframe range cyclically outside the range.
Omit the parameter assignment outside the keyframe range.
Repeat the keyframe range forward then backward outside the range.
